stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, a sudden very bad headache, or sudden weakness, numbness, a drooping face or slurred speech
stop.say: This needs help now. Call 911. Don't wait for a clinic visit.

stop.words: a fever, chills, or a hot, swollen or leaking place after a procedure or an injection; numbness in the groin or inner thighs; new trouble controlling the bladder or bowels; or leg weakness that's getting worse
stop.say: This needs a doctor now. Go to an emergency room, or call 911. Don't wait for a clinic visit.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words texted before a visit get the same message, the owner is told and calls, and the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee

stop.words: taking too much medicine or an overdose, or thoughts of ending a life
stop.say: Call 911 now. For thoughts of self-harm you can also call or text 988, any time.
stop.booking: no booking; the owner is told at once and calls

pf.visit.checkIn: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk, with a photo ID; at home: the code at the door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the doctor reads the health history, takes the history and examines before any procedure, with their own danger checks
pf.visit.changes: a scan only if the doctor orders it, with the price shown first and the patient's yes; a procedure only on the doctor's own order, after the consent, and with the plan's approval where the plan asks; something that needs another doctor first means no procedure, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names; a plan of care is suggested in person, stays on the secure page, and is never pushed
pf.visit.carePlan: a plan of care's visits are booked as a series only with the patient's own yes by text; one reply stops any visit, or all that are left
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; notes, scans and medicine records stay in the clinic's own records, shared with the patient only in person, never in Rosie or a text
pf.visit.away: home visits are consults and medication checks only; no procedure or scan is done at home

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking at the clinic; a card saved only for a procedure visit (the clinic's $150 missed-visit fee), never for a consult; at home: a card saved for the $100 missed-visit fee and charged at DONE, or nothing saved and Rosie texts the bill; a claim visit: nothing taken
pf.money.plans: the plans the clinic takes (its own list); the front desk checks each by hand and records it: active or not, the copay and the deductible; the share is an estimate, not a promise; a procedure's approval is asked where the plan asks
pf.money.claims: an auto or work injury visit is billed to that claim, the business's own way; the claim details go only on the secure page
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay patient is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.packages: none: each visit is paid when it happens; the clinic sells no prepaid visits
pf.money.fees: the missed-visit fee: $150 for a procedure and $100 for a home visit (the example's own), only from a saved card and only when the owner confirms it; the same fee for every patient who may be charged one
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for patients whose plan or the state's rules bar one (like Medicaid, where that applies), or whom the owner marks fee-free; a Medicare patient pays a fee only if every patient does; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: at the clinic: the self-pay price or the plan's share at the front desk, its own way; the clinic sends the plan's claim; a balance after the plan pays is billed by the clinic, not by Rosie's text; at home: the saved card charged at DONE, or Rosie texts the bill; a claim is billed the business's own way
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies, as for every profession: a flat service fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, not a share of the price; no membership is sold here, so no 1% applies. Card payments also carry Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; fee limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules
pf.money.repeatPlans: a repeating visit plan (like a medication check every 4 weeks) is booked only with its own yes; each visit is paid when it happens, like a single visit: at the front desk at the clinic, or at home by the saved card at DONE or Rosfield's bill; no monthly plan charge and nothing paid ahead

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the medicines, procedures, results or the doctor's name (at home, the doctor's name stays, for the door check)

pf.messages.minors: no visits for anyone under 18 (the clinic refers a minor to a pediatric clinic), so no minor's text is sent
pf.messages.decider: for an adult who can't consent, the texts go to the person who decides, and the code to whoever meets the doctor

pf.staff.licenses: each doctor's own state medical license, as the owner gives it

pf.staff.supervision: a medical assistant works only while a doctor is in the building, as the clinic's own rule
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs same-day visits, any price made for one patient (for a procedure, every one), and anything a doctor flags

pf.rules.showLicense: the license shown where the state asks: posted at the clinic, and on a home visit
pf.rules.minors: no visits for anyone under 18 at this clinic
pf.rules.ads: no free-visit or price claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form; no medicine is ordered, refilled or discussed through Rosie

pf.edges.standIn: a doctor out: another doctor with room, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page before any procedure), moves it, or cancels with no fee (A7-74, B7-61)
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay, or a free cancel
pf.edges.redFlagBefore: red-flag words texted before a visit: the emergency room message; the owner is told and calls; the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee
pf.edges.referral: something in the exam needs another doctor first: no procedure, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names
pf.edges.carePlan: a plan of care's visits are booked only with the patient's own yes; one reply stops any visit or all that are left; no sales texts
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with several plan of care visits open: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about medicines or what to do before a visit goes to the clinic; Rosie gives no advice
